title: The founder’s guide to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Everything you need to know
summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 focuses on building enduring companies in the AI era, with programming and speaker lineup designed around this central question. The event explores strategies for founders navigating the current AI-driven business landscape.
content: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is built around one question: How do you build an enduring company in the AI era? Our programming and speaker lineup reflect that.

title: New Mexico court orders Meta to pay additional $567M in child safety case
summary: A New Mexico court has ordered Meta to pay an additional $567 million in a child safety case, bringing the company's total fines to $942 million. The ruling highlights ongoing regulatory scrutiny over Meta's handling of child protection issues.
content: Meta's total fine has raked up to $942 million in this case

zh.title: 新墨西哥州法院命令Meta在儿童安全案件中额外支付5.67亿美元
zh.summary: 新墨西哥州法院已命令Meta在儿童安全案件中额外支付5.67亿美元，使该公司的总罚款达到9.42亿美元。该裁决突显了监管机构对Meta处理儿童保护问题的持续审查。

title: Remembering the pre-Google web, when search was an experiment
summary: The article reflects on the early days of web search before Google's dominance, describing a chaotic period that most people have largely forgotten. It provides historical context on how search technology evolved into the centralized systems we know today.
content: "Most people have completely forgotten how chaotic it really was."

zh.title: 回忆Google之前的网络时代，当搜索还是一个实验
zh.summary: 这篇文章回顾了Google主导之前网络搜索的早期，描述了一个大多数人已基本遗忘的混乱时期。它提供了搜索技术如何演变为我们今天所知的集中系统的历史背景。
